Strategy: Combine the fixed sweet band between thirty and forty-five with a bonus for residuals twenty to forty above the tightest open bin, keeping the mid penalty. This rewards leftovers that are both in the proven band and near the current minimum, but the extra band may rarely trigger and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) + (10 if r - item >= min(bins) + 20 and r - item <= min(bins) + 40 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
